name: Arduino IDE
description: The reviewed Arduino IDE snapshot shows SHA-512 release metadata generation, a Windows signing hook, and a conditional macOS notarization hook. It does not provide auditable application updater methods connecting those artifacts to an in-app retrieval and installation flow; the updater classification remains unresolved.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; a separate updater component or historical release integration is not represented in the reviewed source.
Release signing and SHA-512 metadata establish packaging controls only; they do not establish an in-app updater or runtime verification boundary.
